paper_statement: For a smooth zero-sum loss with bounded derivatives through fourth order, Continuous Adam-DA is locally O(h^3)-close to Adam-DA after max{2 log(h)/log|beta|, 2 log(h)/log(rho)} steps on any fixed finite time horizon.

domain.loss: smooth with bounded derivatives through fourth order

machine_check.burn_in: 50 fixed steps, strictly exceeding the paper threshold for every h

non_circularity: The seven geometric h values, four initial points, and fixed 50-step burn-in were selected independently of any observed errors. No sample count or slope is copied from the formula under test.
